expectations.text: Every operational fact kept (validity, alert lead time, alert name, role, VPN, channel, close window, drain time)
The forgotten backup step (cp current.pem previous.pem) is written as its own command before the swap
The month-end warning comes before the drain step
VPN and billing-ops prerequisites come before the first command
[named] Steps are a numbered list (at least 6 items)
[named] Every numbered step starts with an imperative verb or its condition
Rollback via previous.pem is described after the health check
Removed the chatty and hedged phrasing (basically, you should, I forgot, !!, it's important to note)
